meta.supersedes: committed phase11_condition_baseline.py/.json (commit a9fffc7). Withdrawn: the 0.595 floor (came entirely from the 1,906 duplicated slots of the 28 doubled catalysts); the +0.0215 screening gain (it was the measured-rows diagnostic); the "not seed noise" claim (it rested on seed SD, which is not a test).
meta.protocol: catalyst-grouped 5-fold CV (catalyst_folds), TUNED LightGBM, n_jobs=2, train-fold StandardScaler
meta.per_seed_vs_seed_averaged: per_seed = one value per seed; per_seed_mean = mean of those; seed_averaged_predictions = predictions averaged over seeds, then scored. Differences between arms use only the latter.
meta.B_arms_note: B arms give one catalyst prediction; it is the same under every estimator.
meta.decision_rule: difference detected only if the 95% paired catalyst bootstrap CI excludes zero (n_boot=3000, seed 7, seed-averaged OOF predictions); otherwise "no detectable change". Seed SD is never used as a test.

variance_decomposition.meaning: rmse_floor = row RMSE of a model that knows each cell mean exactly; not attainable for an unseen catalyst
variance_decomposition.not_computed: no floor for grouping by (catalyst, temperature, flows); the old 0.595 came entirely from the 1,906 duplicated slots of the 28 doubled catalysts

fixed_slot_set.rule: by coverage only, before any model output: first of S1, S2, S3 with >= 300 catalysts that have every slot measured

candidates.name: S2
candidates.description: the 18 CH4:O2 = 2 slots at 800 and 850 C

fixed_slot_set.truth_convention: truth_S = max over the measured rows in S; a doubled slot contributes both rows (max over rows, as TRUE_MAX)

estimators.measured_rows_max: NON-DEPLOYABLE DIAGNOSTIC: max over the catalyst's measured rows; truth TRUE_MAX
estimators.full_grid_max: deployable: max over all 135 slots; truth TRUE_MAX is truncated by excluded slots, so biased against condition-aware arms
estimators.fixed_slot_set_max: HEADLINE: max over S; truth_S; complete-S catalysts only

npz_contents: rows_{A,C,Cp}: seed-averaged OOF row predictions in df row order; grid_{A,C,Cp}: seed-averaged OOF predictions (917, 135) in condition_grid slot order; slot_*: the slot table; cat_{B_max,B_median}: seed-averaged B predictions; true_max; grid_C_per_seed (5, 917, 135); row_catalyst, row_slot, fixed_slot_set: int32 index arrays

capacity_check.scope: seed 0 only, arm C, all metrics per single seed; descriptive, no test

subsample_inert_check.what: fold 0 of seed 0, arm C: TUNED (subsample=0.6, no subsample_freq) vs subsample=1.0
